content: Babada nuwanuwadi ma Yesu siloheꞌamasi
Yesu ꞌina heꞌitaedi bewa ꞌilosalohiya, ma ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya,
ꞌigwaeya, “Wasanapuya sabwelo ꞌeluwa ma Hataona Guyaina tapaihowa, ma ꞌoinega taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌagu toteba ꞌiꞌebwaegau ꞌagu ꞌalehao ꞌoidiya, ma kelose ꞌoina siloheꞌamasigau.”
Coinega topwaoli madoudi ma meIsileli ꞌidi babadao siꞌetoꞌautama Kaiyapa ꞌina hada madouna ꞌoina, tauna topwaoliyedi ꞌidi bada madouna.
Ta babadaowedi taudimo siloina ma ꞌabehega ꞌabowega Yesu siꞌabiyahi ma siloheꞌamasi,
ta sigwaeya, “Sahena guyai ꞌalona Yesu taꞌabiꞌabiyahi, ꞌamuge ta tomota sigamwasowala ma siloꞌaleha ꞌoida.”
Wahine Yesu ꞌiheholoiya ꞌasa Bedani ꞌoina
Tutaina Yesu Bedani ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya, Saimoni ꞌina hada. Tauna mwalo tolepelo ꞌaigeda.

Coinega ꞌaigeda wahine maꞌina holowa ꞌilatuma, ma holowaina ꞌana maisa madouna, ma botolo bwebweꞌana hedade ꞌoina sisiweya. Yesu ꞌabwa hadai ꞌiꞌaiꞌai, ma wahineina ꞌilatuma ta holowaina Yesu debana ꞌisiweya.
Ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao siꞌiteya, ta wahineina silomugiyeya, sigwaeya, “Toꞌaha weyahina holowa ꞌimudaliya?
Cilobwaineya ma holowaina ꞌigimwaneye, ma maisa madouna ꞌiꞌewa, ma ꞌiheguyai tohewewelohe ꞌoidiya.”
Ma Yesu ꞌidi gwaeina ꞌisanapuya ta ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena walolomugiye wahine bewa, ꞌina paihowa ꞌoiguwa bwebweꞌana hedade.
Toheweweloheyedi wagwaegwaenedi tuta mabwaiyana simiyamiya deimiya, ma hesi taugu geya tuta dudulena baꞌidamiu tamiyamiya.
Wahine bewa ꞌiheholowa pwaigauwa wahigu ꞌana lagu galiha weyahina.
Yagwae moisa ꞌoimiya, ꞌabwa wasagu tomota siꞌoteteli baleꞌu mabwaiyana ꞌoina, ma wahineina ꞌina paihowa ꞌoiguwa wasana wete siꞌoteteli.”
Yudasa ꞌitagwala ma Yesu ꞌitebaei
Ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌaigeda sanina Yudasa Isakaliyota ꞌitauya topwaoli madoudi ꞌoidiya,
ma ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Cehisa maisa nata waꞌebwaegau, ꞌeguma Yesu ꞌoimiya yatebaeyawa?” Ta mane siliba ꞌana baibaiwa teti siꞌebwaeya.
Coinega Yudasa tuta bwebweꞌana ꞌiyamweya ma ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌitebae ma siꞌabiyahi.
Hataona ꞌaiina sipaihoweya

Hataona ꞌaiina beledi daisina, geya ꞌana ꞌabihesesehamo siꞌaiꞌai. Ta Hataona ꞌaiina ꞌana sabwelo nugeta ꞌoina Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao tupwadi ꞌoina sinaoma ma sigwaeya, “Bada, taꞌeha ꞌoina nuwanuwau ma Hataona ꞌeꞌahaiina weyahiu ꞌaꞌatububu?”

Coinega Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Watauya Yelusalema ma ꞌigu ꞌahwanoi ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌoina wahepwaila, wagwae, ‘Cima toheꞌita ꞌina gwae bewa gide, ꞌabehega “Cigu tuta ꞌilatu pwaiya ma nuwanuwagu ma ꞌino hadai Hataona ꞌaiina maꞌagu tomuliyao ꞌaꞌai.”’”
Ta tomuliyaedi Yesu ꞌina gwaeina simuliyeya, ta loheyaina ꞌina hada Hataona ꞌaiina siꞌatububuya.
Coinega lahilahiya Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelowedi siluhuwa ta ꞌeꞌahaiina siꞌaiya.
Ma ꞌidi ꞌaiina ꞌoina Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Ciyagwao, yagwae moisa ꞌabehega ꞌaigeda ꞌoimiyega nata ꞌitebaegau.”
Ma Yesu ꞌina gwae bewa weyahina sinuwagala moisa, ta ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda Yesu ꞌoina ꞌihesilala ꞌigwaeya, “Bada taiya tauna? Nuwana taugu?”
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Loheyaina tauna baꞌidagu gaeba ꞌaigeda ꞌoinega ꞌaꞌaiꞌai, tauna nata ꞌitebaegau.
Taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌabwa yatautauya ꞌedaina mwalo Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina sihepwaila nugeteya, ma hesi ꞌagu totebaina ꞌatemuyamuyaina, ma bwebweꞌana ꞌeguma mwalo sahena sinana ꞌihehenatune.”
Coinega ꞌana toteba Yudasa ꞌihegwaeya, “Bada to loheya tauna? Nuwana taugu?” Ta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Cugwae pwaiya boꞌi.”
Bada ꞌina ꞌai
Siꞌaiꞌai ma Yesu ꞌeꞌahai ꞌiꞌeweya ta weyahina ꞌigwae helauwa, ma ꞌiꞌabihisiya ta ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Bewa wahigu waꞌewa ma waꞌai.”
Ma waini mabiyona wete ꞌiꞌeweya, ma weyahina ꞌiloyauwedowa Yehoba ꞌoina, ma ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ma ꞌigwaeya, “Mabwaiyami wanuma.
Bewa bweyahigu, loina hauhauna weyahina, ꞌidaudau tomota mabwaiyami ꞌimi puiyao ꞌadi ꞌebe nuwasam weyahina.
Ma yahegwaegomi tuta bewa ma mulina waini bewa geyaꞌabwa ꞌoinega yanumanuma hila ta ꞌana siga ꞌomi baꞌidagwao waini hauhauna tanuma Tamagu ꞌina tupwa.”
Coinega wali ꞌaigeda siwaliyeya ta silatuwa, ma sihaneya ꞌoya Olibe ꞌoina.
Yesu ꞌihepwaila latuwa ꞌabehega Pita ꞌimwehihiye
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Nata nihuwana mabwaiyami wadena sinegau, gide Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila ꞌigwaeya,
Ma taugu ꞌigu toholo hila mulina Galili ꞌoina yatautauya, ta ꞌomi muliguwega wanaowa.”
Coinega Pita ꞌiꞌapulagata ma ꞌigwaeya, “Nata mabwaiyadi sidena sinego ma taugumo baꞌidau.”
Ma Yesu Pita ꞌihegwaeya, “Yagwae moisa, nihuwana nata, muliyetega ꞌabwa ꞌamꞌam ꞌidou, ma ꞌowa matoi ꞌuuhalegau.”
Ma Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, sahena hede yauhauhalego! Ceguma siloheꞌamasigo taugu baꞌidau wete siloheꞌamasigita.” Tomuliyao mabwaiyadi wete gide sihehegwaegwae.
Gedesemani ꞌoina Yesu ꞌiꞌahwanoi
Eeta Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao baꞌidanao sihapwesa tupwa sanina Gedesemani, ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Cebwa wamiyatoi ma yanao nobwa tupwaina yaꞌahwanoi Tamadai ꞌoina,”
ma hesi sitetoiyedi baꞌidanao ꞌitoediya, taudi Pita ma Sebedi natunao, ma ꞌinuwagala madouna, nuwana ꞌisiwapa,
ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Yanuwagala madouna, gide ꞌabwa yaꞌamasa, ꞌebwa wamiyamiya, waꞌoꞌoyatola ma baꞌidagwao taꞌahwaꞌahwanoi.”

Ma ꞌihanaowa tupwana ta ꞌibeꞌusuluwa, ꞌiꞌahwanoi, ꞌigwaeya, “Tamagu yo, ꞌeguma sawasawahina muyamuya biyoina bewa ꞌoiguwega ꞌuꞌewa ma geyaꞌabwa yanumanuma, ma hesi geyaꞌabwa ꞌigu nuwatuhuwega, ꞌowa tuwa ꞌino nuwatuhu gide ꞌupaihowe.”
Cigumwala, ma ꞌihilama ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌilobediya siꞌenosinediya, ma Pita ꞌilohanohanoya, ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Geya sowana sauga ꞌiꞌiuna tuwa waꞌoꞌoyatola ma waꞌabihetegau.
Hede waꞌoꞌoyatola waꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌabehega sahena waluhuluhu ꞌebe tohona ꞌoina. Yaluyaluwami nuwanuwana ma hesi wahimi siweꞌa.”
Cigumwala, ꞌihanaowa wete, ꞌiꞌahwanoiya, ꞌigwae, “Tamagu yo, ꞌeguma geya sowana muyamuya biyoina ꞌuꞌewa, ma ꞌeguma ꞌino nuwatuhu gidemusa, tuwa yanuma.”
Eeta ꞌihilama wete ꞌana tomuliyaowedi ꞌilobediya wete siꞌenosinediya, weyahina mataꞌenoꞌeno ꞌiꞌewa pwaidiya.
Coinega ꞌiꞌebesinediya ꞌebwa, ꞌinaohila ma ꞌiꞌahwanoi matoina, gide nige ꞌiꞌahwanoi ꞌesa.
Cigumwala, ꞌihilama tomuliyaowedi ꞌihegwaediya, “Bwebweꞌana waꞌenoꞌeno, waꞌaiyawasi. Cigu sauga ꞌilatu pwaima, ma ꞌagu totebaina nata taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌitebaegau togalagalaedi ꞌoidiya.
Watoholo, tatauya, waꞌita ꞌagu totebaina ꞌilatu pwaima.”
Yesu siꞌabiyahiya

Cabwa Yesuina ꞌihehegwaegwae, ma Yudasaina ma ꞌina boda baibaiwadi sihapwesama maꞌidi ꞌebe ꞌalehao ma maꞌidi wepasi. Weyahina topwaoli madoudi ma tomota ꞌidi babadao sihewasaedima Yudasa baꞌidanao, ma Yudasaina Yesu ꞌana tomuliya, sitetuwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega,
ma Yudasaina nige ꞌebeheꞌita ꞌihesumanediya, ꞌigwae, “Waꞌita ꞌeguma taiya yaꞌatusapwali, beno loheyaina waꞌabiyahi,”
ma ꞌidumwaluwa Yesu ꞌiꞌatusapwaliya, ta ꞌigwaeya, “Yauwedo Bada.”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Ciyagu, togidega ꞌino naoma?” Cigumwala, ma sitauyama Yesu siꞌabiyahiya.
Siꞌabiꞌabiyahi ma ꞌiyana ꞌaigeda ꞌina ꞌelepa ꞌaleha ꞌilisiloloya ma toloꞌaleha ꞌaigeda ꞌihunuya ma tenana ꞌiꞌupwa yahuleya. Loheyaina topwaoli madouna ꞌina topaihowa ꞌaigeda.
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, “Tuwa, ꞌino ꞌebe ꞌaleha ꞌulagu hila ꞌina ꞌebemiya, ꞌeguma taloloꞌaleha, ꞌabwa ꞌelepa ꞌaleha ꞌoinega taꞌamasa.
Ma hesi wada sanapu ꞌabehega sawasawahina yada ꞌahwanoi Tamaguina sauga bewa ma ꞌida ꞌebwaegau ꞌina aneloseyao ꞌidi bodao tausani ma tausaniyao sabi ꞌabihetegau.
Ma hesi ginaula bewa mabwaiyana silatulatu ꞌabehega toꞌaha mwalo Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina silelediya weyahigu silatuwa.”

Nage ꞌoina Yesu bodaedi ꞌihesilalediya, ꞌigwae, “Taugu ꞌabehega toyagaha ꞌawa, ta maꞌimi ꞌebe ꞌaleha ta maꞌimi wepasi walatuma waꞌabiyahigau. Ma togidega ma mwalo Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌoina yamiyamiya, tomota ꞌoidiya yaheheꞌita ta geya wada ꞌabiyahigauwa?
Ma hesi bewa gide wapaihowa ꞌesa ma ꞌabehega togidega palopitaowedi mwalo weyahigu silelediya ma sauga bewa silatuma.” Eema ꞌana tomuliyao mabwaiyadi siꞌebesineya ma sidena.
Yesu sitoeya toloinao ꞌoidiya
Toloꞌalehaowedi Yesu siꞌabiyahiya ma sitoeya topwaoli madouna Kaiyapa matana, nage ꞌoina loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ma babadao siꞌetoꞌautama.

Ma hesi Pita ꞌana muliya tupwana bwaga, ma siluhuwa Topwaoli Madouna ꞌina ꞌasa, ma Pitaina wete ꞌiluhuwa ꞌimiyatoiya Topwaoli Madouna ꞌina topaihowao baꞌidanao. Cina nuwatuhu ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌana loina ꞌihesagohe ma ꞌiꞌita.
Eeta topwaoli madoudi ma toloinao baibaiwadi nuwanuwadi Yesu ꞌina pui siloba ma ꞌabehega ꞌina ꞌamasa siloine, ꞌoinega siꞌebeꞌebesa toheꞌewao ꞌaboꞌabodi,
ma baibaiwadi siheheꞌewa Yesu ꞌina puiyao weyahidi, ma geya ꞌeta ꞌina pui siloba. Eema ꞌebelosaloha ꞌoina siteluwaedi sinaoma,
sigwaeya, “Yesuina ꞌina gwae ꞌahesagoheya ꞌabehega sowasowana Yehoba ꞌina Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌiligehi yahule ma sabwelo ꞌetoi ꞌoidiya ꞌiꞌabihila.”
Coinega topwaoli madouna ꞌitoholowa, Yesu ꞌihesilala ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha ꞌino heꞌisa ꞌidi heꞌewa bewa weyahiu?”
Ma Yesu tuwa ꞌihehenonomo. Ma topwaoli madouna ꞌihesilala, ꞌigwaeya, “Yehoba miyamiya hatayana matana ꞌuheꞌisa moisa, togidega ꞌowa Keliso, Yehoba Natuna, bo geya.”

Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Cino gwaeina gidemusa. Ma wete yahegwaegomi beno ꞌabwa taugu Loheyaiguina waꞌitegau Tohewaiwaina ꞌina ꞌebeulega yamiyatoi sabi loina, ma wete ꞌigu hilama waꞌita galewa yaloha debadiya.”

Bewa ꞌoina topwaoli madounaina ꞌihegamwagamwaguwa ma tauna ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo ꞌiꞌigaliya, ꞌigwaeya, “Yesuina boꞌi Yehoba ꞌisinaliya. Geya sowana toheꞌewa wete sihehegwaegwae, weyahina Yesuina ꞌina gwae gala hedadena tahesagoha pwaiya.
Togidega ꞌimi nuwatuhu?” Ma mabwaiyadi sigwaeya, “Sowasowana ma ꞌiꞌamasa.”
Coinega tupwadi manina siꞌesoheya, ma tupwadi sisapisapiya ta sihehesilala,
sigwaegwae, “Cabehega ꞌowa Kelisoina, ma sowasowana ꞌuhesumane gide palopita ma ꞌuhegwaemai taiya ꞌisapigowa.”
Pita Yesu ꞌimwehihiya
Ma hesi Pitaina ꞌatamana ꞌimiyatoiya ta ꞌiꞌeꞌebubuna, ma gumalaulau topaihowa ꞌitauya ꞌoina ꞌihegwaeya, “Cowa Yesu gwama Galiliina mwalo baꞌidau wamiyamiya, ꞌawa?”
Ma Pitaina tomotaedi matadiya ꞌimwehihiya, ꞌigwae, “Cino gwaeina huhuna geya yada sanapuya.”
Coinega Pitaina ꞌihapwesa tupwana, ma ꞌaigeda wete gumalaulau ꞌiꞌiteya, ma ꞌiyanao nobwa ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Bewa loheyaina mwalo Yesu gwama Nasaletaina baꞌidana simiyamiya.”
Ma weteyage Pitaina ꞌiꞌetaꞌotaꞌoluluwa ꞌimwehihiya, ꞌigwae, “Loheyaina geya yada sanapuya.”
Sauga ꞌiꞌiuna ma tupwadi toꞌebubunaedi Pita deina sinaoma ma sigwae, “Moisa tuwa, ꞌowa Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda. Cino gwaeina meGalili ꞌidi gwae gidemusa.”
Ma hesi Pitaina maꞌina gwae galana ꞌibwauhaneya, ꞌiꞌetaꞌotaꞌoluluwa, ꞌigwae, “Loheyaina geya yasanapu.” Ma sauga bewa ꞌoina ꞌamꞌam loheyana ꞌidouwa,
ma Pitaina ꞌinuwatuhuya Yesu ꞌina gwaeina ꞌabehega “Muliyetega ma ꞌamꞌam ꞌidou ma ꞌowa matoi ꞌumwehihiyegau.” Cinuwatuhuya, maꞌina nuwagala ꞌihapwesa, ta ꞌidouwa madouna.
